## About
D&J Collision Center, formerly known as D&J Auto Body, has served the Middlesex area for many years. Under new ownership, we have renewed our focus on quality work and good customer service without losing sight of the reputation we built here.
We are a complete repair facility on Lackland Drive East with state of the art equipment, precise paint matching, professional and courteous staff, and I-CAR certified technicians. Some of our people have been with us for many years.
Our mission is simple: do the work right, keep you informed, and build a lifelong relationship with every customer who comes through the door.

## Services
- Collision repair: Complete auto collision repair after an accident or vandalism, done to factory specifications with frame racks, benches and pro spot welders.
- Color matching and frame straightening: We specialize in matching your paint and use current technology to straighten frames.
- Estimates: Fair and accurate estimates so you know where things stand before work begins.
- Towing: If your car is unsafe or can't be driven after an accident, we can arrange a tow straight to our shop.
- Pick-up, delivery, shuttle and rentals: Free vehicle pick-up and delivery, free shuttle service, and a rental car if you need one.
- Dent removal, glass and refinishing: Dent removal, glass replacement, restoration and painting or refinishing.
- Mechanical repairs and wheel alignments: Beyond body work, we handle mechanical repairs, wheel alignments and special repairs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. Working with your insurance company is part of how we handle a repair, so you don't have to manage it all on your own.

Q: My car isn't safe to drive. Can you get it to the shop?
A: Yes. If your car is unsafe or can't be driven, we can arrange a tow to our facility.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are at 256 Lackland Drive East in Middlesex, NJ 08846.
